create_DensePoseDataRelative_from_annota: create a DensePoseDataRelative instance from an annotation dict containing dp_x, dp_y, and dp_I keys
validate_DensePoseDataRelative_annotatio: validate a DensePose annotation dict to check it has required dp_x, dp_y, and IUV or CSE keys
extract_segmentation_mask_from_annotatio: extract a 256x256 segmentation mask tensor from an annotation dict using pycocotools mask decode
apply_transform_to_DensePoseDataRelative: apply horizontal flip and rotation transforms to a DensePoseDataRelative instance updating points and segmentation
move_DensePoseDataRelative_to_device: move a DensePoseDataRelative instance and all its tensor attributes to a specified torch device
